verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a system-level package manager for installing formulae and casks on a machine. Monorepo workspace filtering, such as running installs or scripts on a subset of workspace packages or only those affected by a change, belongs to project and language package managers or monorepo build tools, so it is the wrong axis for Homebrew. Per-project Brewfiles and `brew bundle` only declare machine dependencies and do not make the workspace-filtering axis applicable.
